sinopsis.es: Vida, una joven socorrista iraní, aspira a representar a su equipo en una competición internacional en Australia. La llegada de Sareh, una nueva nadadora tan rápida y talentosa como ella, cambia sus expectativas.
sinopsis.en: Vida is a young Iranian lifeguard swimmer. Popular in her team, she is determined to fight in order to be the one to participate in an international competition in Australia. However, when Sareh, as fast and talented as her joins the team, she will have to face an unexpected situation.
